description: A production-ready REST gateway: send one POST /api/v1/chat request and route it to OpenRouter, OpenCode Zen, Poolside AI, or any OpenAI-compatible provider — with automatic failover, typed errors and zero key exposure.

chatbot.name: Gateway Assistant
chatbot.welcome: Hi! I'm the AI Gateway assistant. Ask me anything about this API — endpoints, providers, models, failover, integration... I run on this very gateway, so if I reply, the API is working. (Reply language: Bangla or English — your choice!)
quickQuestions: How do I call the chat endpoint?
Which providers and models are available?
How do I integrate the API in JavaScript?
How do I add my own custom provider?
